decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several high-performing speakers across different price points. The Raymate Bluetooth speaker (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) emerged as the top choice due to its high rating of 4.6, 30W power output, and IPX7 waterproof rating, all while remaining under $40. While the Harman Kardon and B&O options provide premium sound, the Raymate offers the best balance of features, durability, and value for an outdoor/portable speaker.
